notes.title: ICYMI: The First Big Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Champions!



Here Comes The Swarm got a big update last weekend, in case you missed it, here are all the changes. With the first update comes several new additions, localization, changes, and a ton of bug fixes! Check out everything new and fixed below.

Run into a bug? Let us know on our official Discord.

Thanks and good luck with the Swarm!

-CableHook Games  

Patch Notes from August 21st & 24th.

🎮 Additions
Arcanum Fragments are now rewarded, and two socket slots in the Arcanum can be unlocked

The default language now uses the Steam language

Added voicelines for the narrator

Added localization for the majority of the languages

Added sound to the core destruction on defeat

Improved the soundscape of the settlement by adding reverbs

Added disclaimers to better describe the scope of the Skirmishes in the demo


✏️ Changes
Updated all localization with the latest translated batch

Neutral buildings can no longer be multi-selected

Removed TAA as an anti-aliasing method

Limited the possible resolutions in the dropdown, as it showed a bit too many

Building destruction audio is now also played when the building is manually removed

All abilities now also show up as buffs on the units when unlocked

Improved pathfinding performance

Added more variety to the background music, especially when the final wave is coming

Added reverb to all audio in the world

It is now not possible to leave the Arcanum tutorial

Added demo version logo

Updated the desktop icon to the Arbalist 


🛠️ Fixes
Fixed a bug where the Arcanum tutorial was misplaced when the menu HUD scale was not 1

Fixed bug where some autosaves would fail

Fixed the issue where buildings and units could be added to the same control group

Removed some spammy logs

Fixed the Gain Population talent to actually provide population

Fixed a variety of errors that could slow down the game

Units killed and lost are now also saved, so they are correct in the end screen

Fixed an issue that made it impossible to remove save games while in a match

Fixed the issue where building multiple marketplaces would break them

Fixed bug where completed research would not be unlocked when loading a save

Increased performance for longer-lasting games

Fixed bug where the tutorial lines could not be skipped during cinematics

Fixed bug where keybindings were not working as intended when swapping between grid and non-grid settings

Fixed bug where units could get stuck on a movement order

Fixed bug where the maps would be full of grass if the texture settings were low

Fixed bug where audio could, in some cases, play in the wrong ear

Fixed bug where if two buttons have the same keybind, the first one is used instead of none

Fixed some keybinds that were duplicates by default

Fixed a deep code system issue that would cause a variety of hard-to-find issues

Fixed the issue where the command audio would play on more than 1 actor in the selection

Fixed the issue where the destroy audio would play when dwellings are upgrading
